comment: AI counterparts for the human texts we collected ourselves (issue #46, work package 10; generate.py). Every human text of `sources` gets one prompt on its topic, for one generator, so that topic and source are no longer a shortcut to the label. Model names and prices change: check them before a run.
words_comment: Target length: the word count of the human text, clipped to this range and rounded to 10.
tasks_comment: write: a text on the topic (title or question) of the human one; continue: the opening of the human text is given, only the continuation is kept; rewrite: the human text in other words (what 'humanizer' tools do). A rewrite that stays too close is removed later as a duplicate, the human text is kept.
systems: Write like a person writing for other people: natural and specific, without filler or stock phrases.

held_out_comment: A held-out generator only writes for groups that build_dataset.py puts into the test part, there for this share of them; dataset.json has to name it under held_out.generators, or its rows end up in `main`.
